question: the width-ladder leg has been red every round on the buffer read-back -- is the face wrong, or is the assertion wider than the ruler it is applied to?

leg.diagnosis: the face rounds both ends and the difference separately; two 3-dp ends reproduce that difference to at most one step, so a 1e-9 assertion is unreachable on this shape

repair_options.option: widen the leg to the rounding step
repair_options.change: 1e-9 -> 2 * 5e-4 (the step two 3-dp ends can differ by)
repair_options.pro: one constant; keeps the arithmetic contract testable
repair_options.con: a face that stops rounding would lose exactness (nothing detects it)

repair_options.pro: the difference becomes exactly rebuildable; the leg can stay at 1e-9
repair_options.con: a second set of numbers on the face that must not be read as the headline

recommended: both, in this order: publish the raw ends so the arithmetic is exactly checkable, then have the leg prefer raw when present and fall back to the rounding step when it is not
